On top of the console are two retail boxes for Xbox 360 controllers, both red with Microsoft branding and 'Xbox 360' text visible.
The console has a circular power button with a rainbow-colored ring, typical of the Xbox 360 design.
The front of the console has a disc slot and a label that reads 'XBOX 360' in reverse (due to angle).
The background appears to be a shop or store with shelves and items blurred out.
